title: Office visit — diabetes & hypertension
text:
Patient: John A. Miller   MRN: 4482910   DOB: 03/14/1961   Phone: (419) 555-0173

Chief complaint: follow-up of diabetes and high blood pressure.

Assessment: 64-year-old male with type 2 diabetes mellitus, poorly controlled, with diabetic peripheral neuropathy. Essential hypertension, stable on lisinopril. Hyperlipidemia. Continues metformin 1000 mg twice daily and atorvastatin 40 mg nightly.

title: ED note — shortness of breath (gaps present)
text:
Patient: Maria Gomez   MRN: 7781234   DOB: 22-Aug-1955

72-year-old female presents with shortness of breath. History of congestive heart failure and diabetes. Exam notable for lower extremity edema.

Assessment: acute exacerbation of heart failure. Diabetes — continue current regimen. Chronic kidney disease. Discharged home on furosemide.

title: Cardiology note — well documented
text:
Patient: Robert King   MRN: 9902003   DOB: 11/02/1949   Phone: 419-555-0199

75-year-old male with chronic systolic congestive heart failure (NYHA class III), atrial fibrillation on apixaban, and stage 3b chronic kidney disease. COPD, moderate persistent. Assessment: stable, continue current therapy.
